g.text: wasp node board — block diagram (STM32H723ZGT6 + KSZ8794CNX)
network edge — one upstream, two downstream
The MCU is never in the forwarding path. The switch is
configured once over SPI at boot — storm protection,
self-address filtering, port enables — and forwards on
its own thereafter. No DSA, no tail tagging, no spanning
tree, nothing of ours in the Ethernet hot path.
